Our group is a collection of people around Hanoi of many nationalities and representing different ages and stages of life. 
We currently meet in Tay Ho on Wednesdays from 8:00 to 10:00 PM. 

Many of us have children but our weekly meetings are for the adults, on a rotating schedule:

Week one: all adults, at leaders home 
Week two: women meet, at home or a cafe 
Week three: all adults, at a leaders home 
Week four: men meet, at a home or café

We usually have a facilitated study series that we discuss when all joined together, and on the woman's or men's week we focus more on both our joys and our burdens while encouraging each other.

attributes.description:
CBSI (Community Bible Study International) Ladies group is a group of ladies from HIF and other International churches who are passionate about the Lord. We are an international, mixed age group, inter-denominational, multi-ethnic, and enthusiastic group that are at different stages of our journey (and life) with the Lord. We meet weekly (not only) to share the truths each of us have learned over the week, but to laugh, eat and encourage each other during this season of our lives. 
 
Our ladies community bible study is held every Tuesday morning at 10am. The location of our meetings is usually at Hanoi Club. Please contact us in advance as venue might change due to availability. Please contact us via WhatsApp +852.60569208.
 
We are currently studying the book of Romans. The commanding theme of Romans is God’s power to save. Come and join us to study God’s word and experience His transforming power in our daily Christian life.

Filipino Fellowship Group

The Filipino Fellowship Group is a warm and Christ-centered community where members encourage one another and grow deeper in God’s Word. We gather regularly to pray together, share life’s joys and challenges, and support one another through genuine friendships rooted in love and faith.

Our group feels like a family away from home — a place to belong, grow, and care for each other while reflecting Christ’s love in practical ways. Together, we seek to live out the Gospel and extend His love to those around us.

We meet every Sunday at 1:30 PM (except the last Sunday of each month) at rotating locations, often in members’ homes, cafés, or restaurants. Wherever we gather, you can expect fellowship, encouragement, and meaningful conversations centered on God’s Word.

attributes.description:
Couples Connect
Couples Connect is a warm and welcoming community for Filipino married couples who want to grow together and strengthen their relationships through genuine fellowship. We meet once a month to share life, laugh, pray, and learn from one another as we build marriages that reflect love, faith, and mutual support.

Each gathering is a time to reconnect — with God, with each other, and with fellow couples who understand the ups and downs of married life. Through open conversations, encouragement, and shared experiences, we aim to nurture healthy relationships and stronger family foundations.

Whether you’re newly married or have been together for many years, you’ll find a safe and caring space here to grow in love, friendship, and faith.

Contact Persons: Mhatet, Rhed, and Ernz
Phone: 0977959703

attributes.description:
Planted – Women’s Bible Study

Planted is a women’s Bible study group where faith takes root and friendships grow. We gather to dive deep into God’s Word, share honestly about life, and support one another through prayer, encouragement, and meaningful connection.

In Planted, you’ll find a safe and welcoming space to be real — a place where women of all ages and backgrounds can grow together in faith, grace, and strength. Whether you’re new to studying the Bible or have been walking with God for years, you’ll discover that growth happens best when we’re surrounded by community.

Each week, we open Scripture to understand how it speaks into our everyday lives — our challenges, joys, and relationships. We believe that as we stay rooted in God’s Word and in genuine friendship, our lives will flourish and bear fruit that lasts.

Come as you are, bring your questions, and find connection, laughter, and encouragement among women who want to grow together in Christ.

Contact Person: Ashley
     vunashley@gmail.com
